hints.basics: Start with your name and how employers can reach you. The headline is a short line about who you are, such as your job title.
hints.summary: Write 2-3 sentences about who you are, what you're good at and what you're looking for. It's the first thing a recruiter reads.
hints.experience: Add your jobs, most recent first. Aim for 2-4 bullet points about what you achieved, ideally with numbers. Click a job to edit it.
hints.education: Add your education, most recent first. Degree and school are usually enough.
hints.skills: Type one skill at a time and press Enter. Pick the ones most relevant to the job you're applying for.
hints.languages: Pick a language and your level. Include your native language and any languages you can use at work.
hints.extras: Optional. Add certifications, a driving licence, volunteering or anything else that strengthens your CV.
hints.template: Pick the design you like best. Your content moves over automatically and you can switch at any time.
hints.visibility: Optional. Choose which sections to show, how long the CV may be and which language the headings use.

help.title: About Free Resume
help.intro: A simple, free, and fast way to create a professional CV.
help.step1: Upload your LinkedIn PDF (or start from scratch)
help.step2: Edit content, choose a template, and customize
help.downloadText: Click the "Download PDF" button in the top menu. Your CV is generated directly in the browser.
help.dataText: All CV data is stored locally in your browser (sessionStorage). If you accept analytics cookies, anonymous usage data is sent to Google Analytics to help us improve the service. No personal information is shared.
help.footer: Free Resume is free and open source.
